coverage.summary: Applies to Berkeley rental properties where tenants are evicted so the owner can remove the property from the rental housing market (Ellis Act). The documents state no unit-count, construction-date or owner-type limits.

evidence.quoted_span: The Ellis Implementation Ordinance requires the same relocation assistance payments for tenants evicted so the owner can remove a property from the rental housing market.

result.notes: D004 is the only document that addresses the Ellis Implementation Ordinance. I removed other_conditions ('additional payment applies only to qualifying households') because it describes which tenant households get the extra payment, not which buildings, units or owners are covered. The payment detail belongs in key_value/requirement. I also removed the unverifiable_exemptions entry because it was a missing-information note, not an exemption. No document says whether Ellis coverage is limited to units covered by the Rent Ordinance, so I added no unit, construction or owner limits. requires_unknown_facts is false because the rule is event-triggered and applies to any property withdrawn from the rental market, not to a class of buildings that assessor data cannot identify.
